derivation: a primitive root; properly, to choke; used only as denominative from H6060 (עָנָק),
def: to collar, i.e. adorn with anecklace; figuratively, to fit out with supplies
kjv: compass about as a chain, furnish, liberally.

words.word: compasseth them about as a chain

occurrences.text: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the Lord thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
words: compasseth them about as a chain
